meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当你询问“有没有未发布改动”之类问题时,Claude 会把当前代码和 npm 上已发布的最新版本做对比,逐个查看每个提交的真实改动(不照抄提交说明),再按发布层把改动分类列出,并给出每一层建议的版本号。
howto.when: 当用户提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”等描述时触发;技能会立刻开始比对和分类,不提问题、不说开场白。

say.text: 看看这个仓库相对 npm 上已发布版,有哪些未发布的改动?
say.note: 技能会做代码对比并按发布层整理变更清单。

say.text: 把未发布改动按三个发布层归类,给出每层版本号建议。
say.note: 会输出分层影响矩阵和各层版本建议。

say.text: 相对上一版 npm 发布,这次有哪些破坏性变更,影响哪几个层?
say.note: 会专门标出破坏性变更及影响层。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude compares the repo HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads actual diffs instead of just commit messages, lists unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends a per-layer version bump.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "unpublished changes" or "changelog", etc. It immediately starts the diff-and-analysis flow, with no questions or preamble.

say_en.text: Compare our repo to the published npm version; list unpublished changes.
say_en.note: Diffs HEAD and groups changes by release layer.

say_en.text: Group the changes by release layer and recommend version bumps.
say_en.note: Gives a layered impact matrix and version suggestions.

say_en.text: Which breaking changes in this diff affect each release layer?
say_en.note: Flags breaking changes per affected layer.
